title: billion-context-pi
brief: Rykuuun shared this asking "this is pi-vcc right?", suggesting it's related to a "pi" coding agent with very large context. Details are unverified from the message text alone.
caveat: Details are unverified from the message text alone.
details: billion-context-pi is a Pi coding-agent extension that replaces Pi's built-in auto-compaction with model-driven context compression. Instead of hard-truncating old messages, it gives the LLM a compress tool plus an 8-stage pipeline (assign refs, sync blocks, prune, filter, recommend, nudge, emergency truncate) so the model decides when and what to compress into high-fidelity, labeled, decompressible blocks that stay searchable via search_context. Protected content like user messages and the recent working set is never compressed, and it ships model-facing tools including acp_delegate for clean-context sub-agents. Install with pi install npm:billion-context-pi; MIT-licensed.
